INSERT INTO dcb_tag_heads ("ServiceId", "Tag", "HeadPosition") VALUES (@serviceId, @tag, NULL) ON CONFLICT ("ServiceId", "Tag") DO NOTHING
SELECT "HeadPosition" FROM dcb_tag_heads WHERE "ServiceId" = @serviceId AND "Tag" = @tag FOR UPDATE
SELECT MAX("SortableUniqueId") FROM dcb_tags WHERE "ServiceId" = @serviceId AND "Tag" = @tag
SELECT MAX("SortableUniqueId") FROM dcb_tags WHERE "ServiceId" = @serviceId AND "Tag" = @tag AND (@headPosition IS NULL OR "SortableUniqueId" > @headPosition)
